text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria has been struggling to stay 
in form lately. Hoping for a change of 
pace, we came to visit a shrine—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah—! It's Chrono-chan! Good mor-mile-ing!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Good morn-mile~ Are you here to pray 
too, Gran-chan?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Plus, a change of pace! I've been 
feeling a little off lately.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Oh, in that case... praying here might 
just be the right choice!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
This shrine is said to have dispelled 
slumps for many Umamusume since long 
ago...! Among them were plenty of 
legendary racers, too—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Prestigious Umamusume are here?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, then was there an amazing miler 
too?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Even in the renowned book 
"Umamusume: Everyday Faces," it is 
recorded that many accomplished milers 
have visited this shrine to pay their 
respects!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Oooohhh!! In that caseâ

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Oh Gaaaawd!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Good Mile-niiing!! It's me, Gran 
Alegriiiiaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna become the greatest miler of 
all, so~! Be sure to remember my 
naaaame!!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ummm, and then next is—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I know! I'll run! Because I want you to 
remember me by my running too!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Here we go! Full-power stair daaaash!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, Gran-chan...!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Phew! That is how I run! Don't you ever 
forget it!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! Gran-chan, weren't you supposed to 
not be feeling well...?!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...You're right! I feel like I'm 
doing a lot better now?!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Could it be... that God really...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Waaah~~! Thank you so much, God~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether by divine blessing or not, Gran 
Alegria seemed to have safely recovered 
her form.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Gran Alegria set off running with 
high spirits, but...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*... Huh? That's weird... I 
can't run like I usually do.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No... umm... Didn't you come to pray 
because you weren't feeling well...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Y-You really think so~!? Then I guess I'll 
show off my real skills next time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Gran Alegria's condition remained poor...
